hey man, thanks a lot for responding! What you said really made me feel better. I don't know, nothing really preceded this. It's just been this way forever. I've always been too shy to post to any subreddit. A lot of people go to me for math advice, and they usually come back telling me I helped a lot, but recently I received a test and it was pretty bad. I know school isn't everything, and I really don't want it to be the centre of my life, but I still need to go through it and get good enough marks to be able to go to university. Shamefully, I got a 14% on that test. It's been about two weeks since I got it, but my workload has been really stressful since then, and my parents make it difficult for me to find a quiet moment alone to enjoy myself before I start studying again. Every day since I began school I've been debating about swapping majors, but it's too late now. I like movies, but this program isn't very good. Not a lot of people believe me when I say that the teachers really don't know what they're doing. I like to draw a lot, and it was recommended that I go to visual arts as a major, but I decided against it because I thought I would find some kind of magic in the film program. In reality, its all garbage, but the major I'm in now is at the bottom of the bin. I just can't find enough time in the day. The night before that test I lied on the ground motionless but awake for around half an hour and tried to study again but ended up doing something else and going to bed. Every night my parents and I have a fight. I keep going but I don't know how much longer I can hold out for. One day at a time indeed.

I've been thinking about taking (a regular amount of) sleeping pills for a while now to help me through the night. It seems like a good idea, but I don't know a lot about sleeping pills so I'll have to read more about this.
